title: OpenAI claims GPT-6.2 protein-design capability, commenters dispute &\#x27;intrinsic&\#x27; label
summary: OpenAI claims its GPT-6 models can perform protein-design tasks, saying GPT-6.2 was given the 3D structures of five target proteins and attachment sites and then wrote code to generate 3D minibinder designs without specialized protein AI models. The account also says OpenAI used SolubleMPNN to suggest amino-acid sequences for those designs and other specialized protein models to select candidates predicted to fold and bind at the intended site. Commenters therefore dispute the &\#x27;intrinsic&\#x27; framing, asking what GPT-6.2 actually designed if sequence generation and screening depended on specialized tools.
